text: The purpose of this report is to amend the appointed officers' titles for CreateTO as of December 10, 2018, as well as recommend for approval an amendment in signing authority for CreateTO, as per Attachment 1 due to certain management departures from CreateTO.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Amended the following appointed officers' titles, as of December 10, 2018: - Jaspreet Hansra-Kulasingam, from Acting Senior Lead - Finance and Business Support to Chief Financial Officer - Steven Trumper, from Acting Senior Lead - General Counsel and Corporate Secretary to Chief Legal Counsel and Corporate Secretary 2. Approved the amended signing authority, as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (November 23, 2018) from the Chief Legal Counsel and Corporate Secretary.
